placements.role: Owner and commercial operator of a pure LNG carrier fleet, the tonnage on which the Qatari cargo adjustment lands, and a filer that names the Strait of Hormuz among the routes its shipping is exposed to.

role_evidence.claim: Flex LNG states it is an owner and commercial operator of fifth generation LNG carriers and that it owns and operates nine MEGI LNG carriers and four Generation X Dual Fuel LNG carriers.
role_evidence.source_name: FLEX LNG Ltd. Annual Report on Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, Item 4 information on the company
role_evidence.source_excerpt: EC-34296). We are a growth-oriented owner and commercial operator of fuel efficient, fifth generation LNG carriers. As of February 27, 2026, we own and operate (i) nine M-type, Electronically Controlled, Gas Injection, or MEGI, LNG carriers, of which four have partial re-liquefaction systems installed and three have full re-liquefaction systems installed, which reduce active boil off rates achieved, and (ii) four Generation X Dual Fuel, or X-DF, LNG carriers, which we collectively refer to as our "Operating Vessels" or our "Fleet". Our business is currently focused on the operation of our long-term charters for our Fleet, which is described in the table below, or exploring accretive opportunities to further grow the Company.
